# Crew profile — claude-crew (the crew plugin itself)

<!-- Read by every crew persona before acting. Generated by /crew:init on 2026-09-09, then
     hand-edited. Commit it. This repo IS the plugin: personas, skills, hooks, scripts. -->

mode: optional
tracker: github mike-echo-oscar-whiskey/claude-crew
default-branch: master
branch-pattern: task/{number}-{slug}
designs: docs/design/

## Stack bindings (one line per role; "disabled" turns a role off for this project)

product-owner: backlog is GitHub issues on the tracker repo; README "Using it" table is the product surface
architect: plugin layout under plugins/crew/ (agents, skills, hooks, scripts, templates); manifests in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json and plugins/crew/.claude-plugin/plugin.json; no ADR folder yet, record decisions in docs/design/
frontend-engineer: disabled
backend-engineer: disabled
integration-engineer: the plugin's install and runtime contract with each client (Claude Code plugin manifest, hooks.json, skill frontmatter; Codex equivalents once added); tracker adapter contract in scripts/tracker.sh
event-sourcing-engineer: disabled
genai-engineer: disabled
agentic-ai-engineer: owns the 17 personas in plugins/crew/agents/, the skills in plugins/crew/skills/, hooks/hooks.json, the templates and every bash script in plugins/crew/scripts/ (there is no backend-engineer here); see roles/agentic-ai-engineer.md
multitenancy-engineer: disabled
commercial-analyst: disabled
qa-engineer: no test suite exists; the gate is syntax and manifest validation (see Commands); smoke-run a change with `claude --plugin-dir ./plugins/crew`; see roles/qa-engineer.md
security-engineer: hooks execute shell on every SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit; tracker.sh writes to GitHub through the user's gh token; no secrets stored in the repo
cloud-engineer: disabled
ux-designer: disabled
privacy-and-compliance: disabled
technical-writer: README.md (Install, Using it, Roles, Model per role, Layout) must match the personas and files; every skill's SKILL.md description is user-facing help text

## Commands (in the order they must run)

build:   -
clients: -
test:    bash plugins/crew/scripts/tests/subagent-model.test.sh
gates:   claude plugin validate . && for f in plugins/crew/scripts/*.sh plugins/crew/scripts/tests/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done && jq empty .claude-plugin/marketplace.json plugins/crew/.claude-plugin/plugin.json plugins/crew/hooks/hooks.json && bash plugins/crew/scripts/tests/subagent-model.test.sh
deploy:  -

Gates grow with the repo: when a Codex layout lands, its validation joins the gate line. The first
script witness landed on 2026-09-10 (`plugins/crew/scripts/tests/subagent-model.test.sh`): a witness
is a bare bash script named `<script>.test.sh`, it feeds the script under test a canned input and
asserts on the output, it exits 0 on pass and 1 on the first failure, and every new witness joins
the `test:` and `gates:` lines above.

## Definition of done (walked explicitly by the delivery lead before a PR)

- gates green, exit code quoted
- every behaviour change has RED then GREEN evidence in Verification (failing run quoted before the passing run); a Markdown-only persona or skill edit declares itself test-free in Result and the lead decides
- installable and usable in both Claude Code and Codex; the PR names the command that proved each
- README layout block, roles list and model table match the files and persona frontmatter
- every persona keeps the shared skeleton: profile first, mandate, not-my-job with owner named, how I work, definition of done, evidence block, output contract, escalate-early
- version bumped identically in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json and plugins/crew/.claude-plugin/plugin.json on a release commit

## Exclusive lanes (single-occupancy resources; ask before use when another session may hold it)

- none

## Triage (minimum crew per request kind)

| Request | Minimum crew |
|---|---|
| Question about the plugin | one specialist, read-only |
| Wording or frontmatter change in one persona or skill | agentic-ai-engineer + technical-writer check of the README |
| Script change, hook change, manifest or install-surface change | agentic-ai-engineer + qa-engineer + integration-engineer; security-engineer when a hook or script gains a new command or outbound call |
| Backlog item | full pipeline: refine, plan, work, review |

## Gotchas every role must know

- The copy this session runs on is the installed cache (~/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-crew/crew/<version>/), not this checkout; an edit here is only live after reinstall or `claude --plugin-dir ./plugins/crew`.
- Hook and skill paths are resolved through `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`; a hard-coded path breaks every install but the author's.
- architect, qa-engineer and security-engineer are pinned to `fable`; scout to `haiku`. A pinned model whose allowance is exhausted stops the pipeline with a 429 (seen 2026-09-04): the lead re-issues that run at the persona's default tier or below and names the downgrade (operating model rule 13); see README "Model per role".
- The tracker line above still names the `claude-crew` remote; the planned rename to `crew` moves it, and this line must follow.
